title: Chơi, xem, nghe nhạc: hobbies and free time

vocab.en: to watch, or to look at

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say give me —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cho tôi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say bill —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hóa đơn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say usually —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thường] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say often —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hay] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say sometimes —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thỉnh thoảng] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say never —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: không bao giờ] [EN: Good.]

You have heard it before, inside] [VI: đi chơi] [EN: — to go out, or hang out. Today it stands alone. It has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: .
